description: One hooks module (orchestra.ts): injects the routing protocol at session start; asks the main thread to re-route once a turn hand-edits enforcement.turn_edits distinct files; guards worker subagents against destructive VCS and the shared git stash (enforcement.worker_vcs), against writing the main working tree while they own a worktree (enforcement.worker_tree), and against a second writer in a leased worktree (enforcement.worktree_lease); nudges once per session against generalist subagents that inherit the session model or name Fable (enforcement.opus_generalist) and, opt-in, direct Haiku spawns (enforcement.light_class); removes the session's clean orchestra worktrees at SessionEnd (enforcement.session_cleanup); and shows running orchestra agents and the waves the main thread starts in the status line, toasting each new wave need (userConfig hud). Every guard has escape hatches and fails open
